articles.title: U.S. CFTC opens crypto 'perp' door with first approvals at Kalshi, Coinbase
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has now established a stance on how regulated U.S. firms can engage in crypto perpetual futures contracts.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bittensor (TAO) drops 4%, leading index lower
articles.snippet: Internet Computer (ICP), down 3.8%, was also an underperformer.

articles.title: Paxos wins SEC approval to clear U.S. stocks on blockchain
articles.snippet: Paxos new license positions it alongside legacy giants such as DTCC and makes it a compelling, more efficient alternative for traditional finance giants than legacy competitors.

articles.title: Solana, Sui and Aptos wallet data targeted in TrapDoor package attack
articles.snippet: The campaign targets crypto, DeFi, AI and security developers with fake tooling packages to steal wallets, SSH keys, GitHub tokens, cloud credentials and browser data.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether little-changed despite record stocks, falling oil and easing war fears
articles.snippet: Global stocks hit records and oil cracked on a tentative US-Iran ceasefire extension. Crypto stayed on the sidelines, with some analysts saying the next catalyst is regulatory, not geopolitical.
